items.name: Wrightsville Beach Airlie Live Oak Printed Mug
items.alt: White ceramic mug printed with teal and navy live oak and Spanish moss medallions on ivory, standing on a driftwood plank in the dunes beside a folded cream towel and a shell at Wrightsville Beach, shown as an illustrative image
items.meta: A printed 11 oz white ceramic mug with ink and watercolor live oak and Spanish moss medallions in teal and navy on ivory, inspired by Airlie Gardens. Made to order.
facts: Live oak and Spanish moss pattern wrapped around the mug
